Online course

Decide well, and leave a record your team and its AI tools can follow.

Twenty lessons on stating quality in numbers, comparing options honestly, recording decisions and reviewing a design before it ships. Each lesson has four slides you control, a field guide, a worked case, three recall questions and a lab. Across the twenty labs you build one quality and decisions record for the system you documented at Level 1.

Start the free lessons Get the full course I already have a code

This is self-study: slides, a field guide, a worked case and a lab for every lesson, marked against a rubric you apply yourself. It follows the topics of arc42 (goals, constraints, strategy, decisions, quality and risks) but it is not arc42 training, and it is not an accredited qualification.

03How it teaches

Built from how people learn

Short lessons you control

Four focused slides a lesson, each with a transcript. Move at your own pace and go back whenever you like.

One growing record

After every lesson a lab asks you to produce real work for your own system: quality tree, scenarios, budgets, decision records, contracts, a risk review. The twenty answers join into one record you download at the end.

Built on arc42 and its sources

The lessons follow arc42 sections 1, 2, 4, 9, 10 and 11 and the Q42 quality model, with ADRs, ATAM-style review and fitness functions. Each lesson cites the page it draws on.

Decisions in the AI era

Two lessons use 2026 research on LLM-drafted decision records and show how to write decisions that coding agents can read and checks that stop them breaking the rules.

Practice tools you can run

A scenario checker tells you if a quality scenario is testable, and a budget calculator handles downtime, error budgets, dependencies, latency, capacity and debt payback, in your browser.

Mark your own work

Each lab has a model solution and a four-criterion rubric. Score yourself 0, 1 or 2 on each, then close the gaps.

Pause and recall

Three questions at the end of each lesson, with the reason for each answer. Your progress is stored in this browser only.

Retrieval practice and spacing are among the best-studied learning techniques, so each lesson ends by asking what you remember before it shows you.

    06Questions

    Before you decide

    Who is this for?

    Developers and architects who have written or read an arc42 or similar documentation and now need to set quality goals, decide between options and defend the result.

    Do I need Level 1?

    No, but you should be comfortable reading architecture documentation. The lab builds on a system you have already described.

    How do I get access?

    Message sales on WhatsApp. We reply with how to pay and send your access code when payment is confirmed.

    Can I share my code?

    Please do not. The code is personal and your name appears on every lesson.

    Is this arc42 certification?

    No. It is Intellica self-study that follows the arc42 topics. It does not give iSAQB or arc42 credentials.

    What about refunds?

    Refund terms are confirmed in writing when you enquire, before you pay.
